meta.title: Finance / Tax / MDM Review: not available on the Growth plan
gaps: Open and inspect Finance / Tax / MDM Review on a Growth-plan tenant.
Verify that the Growth-plan capability is refused or absent for a Finance Controller.
Set only the TDS code and rate through the dedicated review step.
Repeat the same Finance Controller interaction on an Enterprise-plan tenant and verify it is available.
Compare the same user's outcome across Growth and Enterprise plan tenants.

plan.title: Finance Tax MDM Review Plan Availability

args.need: sign in as the Finance Controller on the Growth-plan tenant, attempt Finance / Tax / MDM Review and set only the TDS code and rate, then repeat the same steps on the Enterprise-plan tenant and report whether the capability is absent or available

steps.note: A tester must provide the persona sessions, plan-tier tenants, Finance / Tax / MDM Review screen, and TDS controls that no catalog step can reach or observe.
Confirm the session remains free of a crash or server error after the tester's interaction; this does not substitute for the missing capability assertions.
